Chapter 1 – The Shop on Willow Street


The clockmaker’s shop sat quietly between a bakery and a tailor. Tomas, twelve years old, stepped inside and entered a world of brass gears and steady ticking. He did not yet know how much this place would change him. Time reveals what we overlook. This short follows a young apprentice who discovers that every tick of a clock carries meaning.

paragraphs.title: Paragraph 1
paragraphs.content:
Chapter 2 – Master Aurelin

Master Aurelin spoke little but understood every machine. He taught Tomas that clocks were not just built, they were listened to. “Every mechanism has a story,” he said.
